title: Former NASA specialist claims he has found a way to overcome Earth's gravity in a 'major discovery'
summary_full: A former engineer from NASA has made an exciting claim regarding propulsion technology. His company has engineered a device that generates thrust purely through electric fields, without expelling any mass. This groundbreaking technology has shown consistent improvements in force generation over several years. Upcoming space demonstrations are expected to exhibit the full potential of this cutting-edge innovation.
